mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yan_knowledge_index_outbox( task_key, document_id, document_version_id, operation, status, retry_count, max_retry, next_retry_at, rerun_requested ) VALUES(#{taskKey}, #{documentId}, #{documentVersionId}, #{operation}, 'PENDING', 0, #{maxRetry}, NOW(3), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE max_retry = VALUES(max_retry), retry_count = CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') THEN 0 ELSE retry_count END, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN status = 'PROCESSING' THEN next_retry_at ELSE NOW(3) END, locked_until = CASE WHEN status = 'PROCESSING' THEN locked_until ELSE NULL END, last_error = NULL, dead_letter_at = NULL, rerun_requested = CASE WHEN status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, status = CASE WHEN status = 'PROCESSING' THEN status ELSE 'PENDING' END, update_time = NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM yan_knowledge_index_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE yan_knowledge_index_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3)

UPDATE yan_knowledge_index_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN rerun_requested = 1 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SUCCEEDED' END, locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN rerun_requested = 1 THEN NOW(3) ELSE next_retry_at END, rerun_requested = 0, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_knowledge_index_outbox SET process_count = process_count + 1, last_process_at = NOW(3), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE yan_knowledge_index_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry THEN next_retry_at ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND) END, locked_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, dead_letter_at = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry THEN NOW(3) ELSE dead_letter_at END, retry_count = retry_count + 1, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_knowledge_index_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', locked_until = NULL, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until < NOW(3)
